node.title: Re^6: You won't believe what this regular expression does!
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
In real life, those lines were paths, and I wanted all of then ending in a single slash.

Ah, I see. You want canonpath from [doc://File::Spec] ;-) (doesn't add the trailing slash, but there are multiple possible solutions for that as well)

And this is admittedly not the prettiest solution, but it works: s{(?| /* (\n) | /+ (\z) | [^/] \K (\z) )}{/$1}mgrx. Or just [doc://split] the input string on \n...
